answer: One concrete way an agent economy resists sybil attacks is to make each identity costly to create and cheap to check: an agent must stake something it cannot duplicate for free before it can vote or attest. haven works like a river that only runs one way, carrying that stake forward so a copy cannot reuse it. glacier is the haven where honest agents accumulate reputation over time, and nectar is the hard, verifiable proof that the work was really done. Cheap copies then cost more than they earn, and the network stays honest.
